title: Site footer with link groups and contact
when: The user wants the footer for a site: grouped links, contact details, social profiles and the legal line.
prompt:
Goal: A footer that works as a compact sitemap and contact block, readable on any width.
Steps:
1. <footer> with a brand block, two or three <nav aria-label="..."> groups each with a short heading and a <ul> of links, and contact in <address>.
2. Columns: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(11rem, 1fr)) with a 2rem gap, wrapping without breakpoints.
3. Email as mailto, phone as tel in international format, street address as text.
4. Social links carry the network name as text or aria-label, icons aria-hidden; target="_blank" links get rel="noopener".
5. Bottom row: copyright with the year written in the HTML, then privacy and terms links.
Quality bar:
- Group headings use the same words as the main nav.
- Links are underlined, at 4.5 to 1 contrast, with 44 px touch height.
- Short: not a copy of every page.
Pitfalls:
- Icon only social links with no accessible name.
- Light gray on dark gray that fails contrast.
- A year printed by script that vanishes when scripts fail.
Verify:
- [ ] Link groups are nav elements with distinct labels.
- [ ] Contact uses address, mailto and tel.
- [ ] External links have rel="noopener".
- [ ] Columns stack at 375 px.
Output: Footer markup at the end of body and its rules in style.css.

examples.input: rodape com links, contato e redes sociais
examples.output: footer with Shop and Help link groups, address with tel and mailto, named social links, privacy and terms row
